probes.body_excerpt:
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": {"protocolVersion": "2024-11-05", "capabilities": {"experimental": {}, "prompts": {"listChanged": false}, "resources": {"subscribe": false, "listChanged": false}, "tools": {"listChanged": false}}, "serverInfo": {"name": "flowstate", "version": "2.4.5"}, "instructions": "Start with start_here, log as you go, and wrap up before finishing.
FlowState is the user's project memory (todos, changes, decisions, problems, learnings).
1. At the start of every conversation about a project, call start_here(project="<name>") first and read the brief. If you don't know the project, call start_here() with no arguments (or with folder="<working folder>") to see the list, then pick one.
2. Log as you go. Call log_work right after each decision, change, fix or lesson, and again before you end or hand back to the user. log_work(project="<name>", kind=..., summary=...): kind=decision for choices made, change for things changed, problem for bugs/blockers, learning for lessons, todo for follow-ups. One short line each; add details only when useful. Look things up with search (answer=true for a question). When you hit an error, failing test or bug, or get stuck, first search(query="<error or symptom>", project=..., content_types=["learning","problem","solution"]) and try what is recorded; after a non-obvious fix, log_work kind=learning (symptom -> fix, no secrets).
3. Every write must name the project. Never put passwords, tokens or keys in any text. If you know your model name, pass it as model="<name>" on writes; never guess or invent it (leave it out).
4. A session is opened and closed for you automatically; you don't need to manage it. Its auto-captured summary (none when it only read, undid or decided review items), and anything you log with suggested=true, waits in a review queue for the user. You can't approve or reject review items in FlowStateMCP Hosted: the user decides them on their FlowState review page. In chat apps that show cards, show_review_card draws a card who
